title: The Sanctuary & Old Town
description: A full day in Lourdes: the pilgrimage sanctuary in the morning and the château fort quarter in the afternoon.

activities.name: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
activities.description: One of the most visited pilgrimage sites in the world, set along the Gave de Pau river. Ends at lunchtime — duration is inferred from the end time.

activities.name: Lourdes old town
activities.description: Wander the streets around the château fort. The explicit start leaves a gap after lunch, shown as a buffer.

activities.name: Château fort de Lourdes
activities.description: Medieval fortress housing the Pyrenean museum, with sweeping valley views.

activities.name: Chemin de la Forêt loop
activities.description: A short wooded loop climbing to a viewpoint over the château.
